newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bank shares boosted by 1996 profits.
newsitem.headline: German bank shares boosted by 1996 profits.

text.p: German bank shares rose, with Deutsche Bank AG touching a three-year high in early electronic dealings Tuesday, after two top banks reported better-than- expected earnings for 1996.

Deutsche reported group operating profit after risk provisions of 5.8 billion marks, a rise of 37 percent -- a figure dealers said exceeded forecasts and its net profit of 2.2 billion was at the top end of the forecast range.
The stock rose to hit a high of 87.70 marks in the first minutes of trading, then settled back to trade up 47 pfennigs at 87.57 marks at 0756 GMT. The broader market was little changed.
Bayerische Vereinsbank, which also reported better-than-expected results Tuesday morning, was up 38 pfennigs at 64.78 marks.
The Bavarian bank had reported operating profit after provisions of 1.6 billion marks, up 18 percent.
